findings: C2 MAJOR: .claude/workflows/framework-evolution-scout.js:96 permits Verify gap_id=none; shared adjudicate at :499 does not enforce open-gap eligibility. Independent production-body replay using real strict schema conversion returns COMPLETE and APPROVED=1 in sweep; identical punctual response is REJECTED. Tool output 77199f. Reproduce via run(evolution,{}, {'verify:owner/one':{...verdict,gap_id:'none'}},{strict:true}) from scripts/test-scout-workflows.mjs. Minimal fix: enforce valid open-gap eligibility in shared deterministic adjudication while retaining legitimate no-gap rejection/opportunity disposition; add strict fixtures for both modes and downstream bookkeeping refusal.

C4 MAJOR: scripts/evolution-bookkeep.mjs:84-90 trusts sweep bucket classification without reconciling each candidate verdict/hard facts; :147 writes literal APPROVED. Independent real CLI execution in isolated OS temp accepted a valid sweep modified only with approved[0].verdict=REJECTED and approved[0].hard.safety=FAIL, exited 0, appended APPROVED and incremented registry approved. Tool output 4cc118 also shows C2 gap_id=none output can be booked. Minimal fix: validate bucket/verdict/hard/redteam/score consistency before any write, respecting the producer's distinct compact rejected/killed schemas; retain positive bookkeeping and add byte/mtime zero-write rejection tests.
Native multi-turn product behavior and OS sandbox effectiveness remain UNKNOWN; static checks and mock transport executions do not establish dual-harness E2E. A6/A7 remain future publication gates.
